text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"—Was that the last of it? Well, we got
everything on the list, so let's head home."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's City-cha~n!
Whatcha up to, out shopping~?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pretty much. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Remember that game 'Pioneer Together! Adventure Island' that was super popular back in grade school?
I'm on my way to their pop-up shop!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that brings back memories.
You mean the one where you develop an uninhabited island and live there, right?
choice_data_list: In that case, I used to be pretty into that myself...
In that case, I used to be pretty into that myself...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!? Let's go then!!
It's totally gonna hype us up☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The fidelity is insane~
The photo standees and stuff look straight out of the game!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh... That's pretty elaborate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
They're selling actual game costumes
just as they are... That's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy☆
For now, let's get changed~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Default avatar is just the best, hands down~~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back. For a while, I walked around dressed like this,
picking up fruit and seashells to sell for cash."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
These clothes were pointlessly expensive~
I was torn between buying this or expanding my house.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I get it, I get it!
I ended up buying clothes and went totally broke again~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, did you find anything good, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Um, yes.
I thought that flared dress over there looked nice.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It feels more natural than resort-like,
and with the lighter tones and airy fabric,
it shows off the body's lines while keeping a relaxed feel... andâ

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No. It's just... I'm more stuck in the "City the Model" mindset than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
When I'm picking out clothes, camera angles, locations,
how they'll look under the lighting... all of that comes flooding to mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Without realizing it, I'm trying to become the person everyone wants me to be.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I can't just like whatever I like and do whatever I want like Jordan and the others.
choice_data_list: It's not for work, so feel free to pick whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"That's true. ...An occupational hazard, maybe?
It's hard to separate the two."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
For better or worse,
maybe that's just who I am right now.
choice_data_list: Maybe we can manage if we borrow the other girls' help?
Then let's have fun as the City you are right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What other girls? ...For example?
choice_data_list: Of course, everyone who invited me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You want me to go join them again?
But just now—
choice_data_list: Next time, try not to overthink it and just leave it to them.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Leave it to them, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, what's up? What happened?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna hear everyone's thoughts.
Got any outfit recommendations for me?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totes! My top recommendation is this one!
A gorgeous yukata style!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the thing they were selling at the summer festival event!
I missed out on buying it and totally regretted it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Next is me, me!
Super adorbs at home☆ Pajama coord!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I might actually like this pink...
There was a surprisingly wide variety of pajamas, wasn't there?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"How about this?
Matching with the executives has a nice, refined vibe, don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That character's great, isn't he?
I really liked the cafe master too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, haha.
Man. That really brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! There's an outfit
I'd like to recommend too—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So, I bought a bunch of stuff and took some photos.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Why don't you have them pick one for you too? You might feel like a kid again, you know."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I was treated like a dress-up doll for a while,
but Gold City seemed to be having fun,
so I let it slide.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
With how I am right now...
Wait, what does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her this was her chance to see for herself
how much better she's become at styling amazing outfits,
even with the exact same lineup as back then.
choice_data_list: Like competing against your past self!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
――……
Sounds good. I'll give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
How about something like this?
I think it'd go well with the sea or the beach.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, looking nice and fresh~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Holy moly☆
Don't I look, like, insanely refined right now!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
City's eye for fashion is spot on.
It looks totally awesome on you too, Heliosâª

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed...
This might actually be pretty fun."
choice_data_list: Could you help pick out clothes for me too, if you don't mind?
Could you help pick out clothes for me too, if you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sure.
I'll put together the perfect outfit for you.
